title: Al-A'la 87:16-19 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 25 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-A'la 87:16-19 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 25. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا (١٦) وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ (١٧) إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ (١٨) صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ (١٩)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: But you prefer the worldly life,
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Laam of a particle (بَلْ): said clearly
Idgham with ghunnah: tanween before و

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-A'la 87:16-19 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 87:16-19 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 87:16-19 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of Al-A'la 87:1 to 19 to a partner in a breakout room.
questions.a: Nineteen ayat; partner notes any slips.

questions.q: Which two prophets' scriptures are named in 87:19?
questions.a: Ibrahim and Musa (peace be upon them).
A) The Hereafter. 87:17: 'While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.'

questions.q: How many ayat are in Al-A'la?
Think again: 'But you prefer the worldly life, while the Hereafter is better and more enduring' (87:16 to 17). Give an example of choosing the lasting thing over the quick thing.
questions.a: Praying on time instead of finishing a game; giving sadaqah instead of buying another treat.
